one_liner: GoHighLevel has a broad REST API v2 with OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens, plus an official MCP server, but API access requires a paid plan (trial only).
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (agency/location tokens) for Marketplace apps; Private Integration Tokens are static bearer tokens created in Settings. Sources conflict on whether OAuth needs Agency Pro; the official help center says OAuth is available on all plans.
access_notes: No free tier. API comes with paid plans (Starter $97+). A 14-day standard trial (card required) gives working access. Some endpoints (Create Sub-Account, Enable SaaS) need Agency Pro.
blocker_notes: A paid HighLevel subscription (or time-limited trial) is needed for API credentials. Some endpoints need Agency Pro.

evidence.quote: Both **OAuth 2.0** and **Private Integration Tokens (PIT)** are available across all plans, allowing developers to build integrations and access supported APIs
Agency Access Token - Used for agency-level operations - Access to agency and sub-account data - Obtained through OAuth 2.0 flow
certain endpoints require an Agency Pro ($497/month) subscription.
